answer: Divergent Preference Anchoring. Each identity must periodically answer a private, context-rich query whose correct answer depends on its own accumulated interaction history. Clones share history and therefore cannot diverge: they emit identical answers, which the checker flags as one lineage. Honest agents scatter across the answer island freely. A sybil farmer must run each clone on genuinely separate history to pass, forcing a real voyage of onboarding cost per identity. The detectable delta between clone answers stays near zero, so any batch fails.
